config.n_pages_deviation: 14336 instead of DESIGN 4.2 sketch 20480: measured TEXT ~2217 B/page would saturate the 48 MiB pool in phase 0 (see traces.crash docstring)
config.ocp_sensitivity_formula: modeled_ns(window) = (delta WRITES + delta READS + delta PROMOTES) * ocp_ns for ocp_ns in [150, 250, 500, 1000]; zlib emulation cost is the tier's measured COMP_NS_TOTAL+DECOMP_NS_TOTAL and is excluded from the modeled series (factored out per the E0 calibration argument)
config.r3_reclaim_formula: (delta WRITES * 4096 - delta PHYS_USED) / (delta R3 + delta R1) over 500-op phase-1 windows with delta R3 > 0. CAVEAT: phase-1 writes are REWRITES; each also frees the old in-pool copy (TEXT, ~2.2 KB) unless it was already spilled, so this estimate is biased UP by that freed-copy volume. It is comparable across victim policies (same bias); the clean measured per-spill metric is spill_bytes_w_per_spill (SPILL_BYTES_W per spill event)
